annotations.title: Latest clean profile of one plan

description:
The plan as of its latest filing: identity and status, plan type and features, assets and
participants, average balance and approximate return, recordkeeper, advisors and auditor, headline fees,
screening signals and data-quality flags.

When the latest year is a small-plan filing (no Schedule C), the recordkeeper shown is the last one seen
on an earlier Schedule C, labeled with its year and a lower confidence. `availability` says which years
`get_plan_history` and `get_plan_fees` will return.

Price: $0.03 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport), or from card credits (an app signed in at /connect, or an 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /plan of the Plan Data API.

pn.description: Plan number (1-999; 1 and 001 both work). Optional when the EIN sponsors only one retirement plan; otherwise the error lists the plans to choose from.
